narrative.details:
Many blacksmiths believe that mining and smithing are separate, independent jobs; but can there be blacksmithing without mining? Ah ha -- it is an impossibility! The accomplished blacksmith must also be an accomplished miner.

Show Galvan that you are capable, adventurer. Bring me forty bars of iron and forty bars of mithril. For this, Galvan will teach you the ways of the ornate mithril pants!
narrative.objectives: Bring forty Mithril Bars and forty Iron Bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.
narrative.offerRewardText: Your work ethic is impeccable, adventurer! You are starting to understand the ways of Galvan mineralogy! Take this and learn from it all that you can.
narrative.requestItemsText: After such mining, your muscles bulge and your body aches!
